```{r}
#| label: mahalanobis-eigen-3d-alt
#| echo: false
# The alt text, saved once for the figure and its interactive widget.
fig_alt_mahal_surf <- paste(
  "Surface plot of the Mahalanobis distance for a bivariate normal density",
  "with variances 2 and covariance 1, over x1 and x2 from -3.5 to 3.5.",
  "The surface is a cone with its tip at the origin,",
  "stretched along the line x2 = x1 and squeezed along the line x2 = -x1,",
  "so its horizontal slices are ellipses.",
  "The slices at heights 1 and 2 are drawn as red contour lines.",
  "Two dots on the inner contour, at height 1, mark the points",
  "that are the square root of 3 along (1, 1) over the square root of 2",
  "and 1 along (1, -1) over the square root of 2."
)
```

:::{#fig-mahalanobis-eigen-3d}

```{r}
#| label: mahalanobis-eigen-3d-plot
#| code-fold: true
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt_mahal_surf
mh3_entries <- c(2, 1, 1, 2)
mh3_covmat <- matrix(mh3_entries, nrow = 2)
mh3_inverse <- solve(mh3_covmat)
mh3_x1 <- seq(-3.5, 3.5, length.out = 101)
mh3_x2 <- seq(-3.5, 3.5, length.out = 101)
mh3_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(x1 = mh3_x1, x2 = mh3_x2)
mh3_points <- as.matrix(mh3_grid)
mh3_quad <- (mh3_points %*% mh3_inverse) * mh3_points
mh3_sums <- rowSums(mh3_quad)
mh3_dist <- sqrt(mh3_sums)
mh3_n_x2 <- length(mh3_x2)
mh3_z <- matrix(mh3_dist, nrow = mh3_n_x2)

# The points of the example: sqrt(3) q1 and q2, each at distance 1.
mh3_long <- sqrt(3 / 2)
mh3_short <- 1 / sqrt(2)
mh3_marks_x1 <- c(mh3_long, mh3_short)
mh3_marks_x2 <- c(mh3_long, -mh3_short)
mh3_marks_z <- c(1, 1)
mh3_marks <- tibble::tibble(
  x1 = mh3_marks_x1,
  x2 = mh3_marks_x2,
  z = mh3_marks_z
)
mh3_marker <- list(color = "black", size = 5)
mh3_contours_z <- list(
  show = TRUE,
  start = 1,
  end = 2,
  size = 1,
  color = "red"
)
mh3_contours <- list(z = mh3_contours_z)
mh3_stops <- c(0, 1)
mh3_cols <- c("#CCE0F0", "#0072B2")
mh3_scale <- list(mh3_stops, mh3_cols)
mh3_eye <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
mh3_camera <- list(eye = mh3_eye)
mh3_xaxis <- list(title = "x1")
mh3_yaxis <- list(title = "x2")
mh3_zaxis <- list(title = "Mahalanobis distance")
mh3_scene <- list(
  xaxis = mh3_xaxis,
  yaxis = mh3_yaxis,
  zaxis = mh3_zaxis,
  camera = mh3_camera
)
mh3_widget <- plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = mh3_x1,
    y = mh3_x2,
    z = mh3_z,
    contours = mh3_contours,
    colorscale = mh3_scale,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    data = mh3_marks,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    showlegend = FALSE,
    marker = mh3_marker
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = mh3_scene)
htmltools::div(
  role = "img",
  `aria-label` = fig_alt_mahal_surf,
  mh3_widget
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| results: asis
cat(
  "*(This 3D surface is interactive; see the HTML or slide version",
  "of this page to view it.)*"
)
```

The surface whose contours are in @fig-mahalanobis-eigen:
the Mahalanobis distance, a cone whose horizontal slices are the ellipses.
The red lines are the contours at $1$ and $2$,
and the dots are the points $\sqrt{3}\,\vecf{q}_1$ and $\vecf{q}_2$ of the example on the inner one.
:::
